title: Manifest data/d8/hoggar/manifest.json of the Hoggar lines (d = 8, 3-qubit Pauli covariant)
description: The Hoggar lines are an exceptional d = 8 entry: covariant under the 3-qubit Pauli group, NOT under the Z/8 Weyl-Heisenberg group, and not part of the 174-ray Weyl-Heisenberg catalogue. The files are added directly as data (no SICX, no generator in the repository); see docs/data.md#8-the-hoggar-lines-datad8hoggar. Canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace, one trailing newline).

basis.description: tensor decomposition and qubit ordering (MSB first, as docs/data.md#hoggar-covariance-and-exact-proof)

pauli.description: P_{a,b} = (X^{a_1} Z^{b_1}) (x) (X^{a_2} Z^{b_2}) (x) (X^{a_3} Z^{b_3}) with its action on the basis

status.description: status words of docs/verification.md; the exact SIC property of the fiducial is proved by integer arithmetic over Z[i]

files.description: file names in this folder; hashes are in data/catalogue.json

included.description: whether all.npz contains the Hoggar ray
